lines.en: label day269:
scene norikointro1
Wednesday begins with somewhat of a change of fate.
lines.zh: 周三以某种命运转折的方式开始了。

lines.en: Or, as a certain normal [teenage]girl would likely say instead, the result of an unfortunate twist in an otherwise unbending cycle.
lines.zh: 或者，用某位普通的[teenage]女孩更可能会说的话来讲，是本该一成不变的循环里一次不幸的扭曲。

lines.en: Or something along the lines.
lines.zh: 大概就是那一类的意思。

lines.en: I actually took it upon myself to inform Maya of Kirin’s transfer plan the other day and, just as expected, something like this has never happened before.
lines.zh: 前几天我其实主动把 Kirin 转班的打算告诉了 Maya，而正如预料的那样，这种事以前从未发生过。

lines.en: Instead of getting philosophical, however, she just sighed to herself and ran her fingers through her hair, saying something I can’t quite remember as she walked off.
lines.zh: 不过她并没有抒发什么感慨，只是自顾自地叹了口气，用手指拢了拢头发，一边走开一边嘟囔了句我已经记不太清的话。

lines.en: I imagine she just called me disgusting. She does that often.
lines.zh: 我猜她大概是骂我恶心吧。她经常这么干。

lines.en: Sure, the context of the rest of the conversation didn’t really invoke any need for me to be insulted, but that’s never stopped her before.
lines.zh: 当然，那番对话的前后文其实完全没给她任何骂我的理由，不过这一点从来也没拦住过她。

lines.en: Why stop now? When things are finally becoming new and exciting?
lines.zh: 何必现在停手呢？毕竟事情终于变得新鲜又刺激了。

lines.en: Or terrible.
lines.zh: 或者变得很糟。

lines.en: I guess we’ll just have to wait and see.
lines.zh: 我想我们只能等着瞧了。

lines.en: : Soooo...hey!
: I’m Kirin Kanda, and I’ve met pretty much all of you already since I totally crashed your Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 我是 Kirin Kanda，因为之前把你们的圣诞派对给彻底搅了，所以基本上已经见过你们所有人了。

lines.en: : But I guess I’m here to crash your class now as well.
lines.zh: : 不过看来，我现在是要来搅你们的课了。

lines.en: : I’m not expecting any sort of warm welcome or anything like that, but-
lines.zh: : 我并不指望什么热烈欢迎之类的，不过——

lines.en: scene norikointro2
: HECK YES! KIRIN KANDA AND MIKU MARUYAMA IN THE SAME CLASS!
lines.zh: : 他妈的太棒了！KIRIN KANDA 和 MIKU MARUYAMA 同一个班！

lines.en: : EVERYBODY GIVE HER A ROUND OF APPLAUSE!
lines.zh: : 大家一起为她鼓掌！

lines.en: : Uhh...no. Please don’t do that.
lines.zh: : 呃……别。请不要这样。

lines.en: scene norikointro3
: What I was trying to say before Miku jumped in...is that I hope we can all get along and...you know, be normal students together or whatever.
lines.zh: : 在 Miku 插进来之前我想说的是……希望大家都能好好相处，然后……你们知道的，一起当普通学生之类的。

lines.en: scene norikointro4
: Sooooo...yeah. I guess if anyone has any questions or anything like that, I’d be more than happy to answer.
lines.zh: : 所……以呢……对。如果有人有什么问题之类的，我非常乐意回答。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == False:
: If not, I’ll just take my seat and we can all pretend that I’ve been here the entire time and didn’t just randomly show up one day.
lines.zh: : 如果没有的话，我就直接坐下了，然后大家就都假装我从头到尾一直在这儿，而不是某天突然冒出来的。

lines.en: The class remains silent for a moment apart from Miku’s cheering and several other girls who she’s able to coax into awkwardly clapping for Kirin.
lines.zh: 全班沉默了片刻，只有 Miku 在欢呼，还有几个被她哄着尴尬地为 Kirin 鼓掌的女生。

lines.en: Kirin doesn’t react, of course.
lines.zh: Kirin 当然毫无反应。

lines.en: She doesn’t look to me for approval, either.
lines.zh: 她也没有看向我寻求认可。

lines.en: In fact, she basically doesn’t even acknowledge my existence as soon as she gets the ball rolling.
lines.zh: 事实上，一旦她把事情推动起来，她基本上连我的存在都不承认了。

lines.en: It’s possible that she’s just trying to avoid raising suspicion, but-
lines.zh: 她可能只是想避免引起怀疑，不过——

lines.en: Isn’t that the opposite of what she’d normally do?
lines.zh: 这和她平时的作风不是正好相反吗？

lines.en: Is a normal introduction in a room full of people she knows truly fun to her?
lines.zh: 在一屋子她认识的人面前做个普通得不能再普通的自我介绍，对她来说真的有意思吗？

lines.en: else:
scene norikointro5
: I’ve got a question.
lines.zh: : 我有个问题。

lines.en: : Oh! Ayane, my best friend in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 哦！Ayane，我在这广阔世界上最好的朋友。

lines.en: : Whatever can I do for you?
lines.zh: : 我能为你做点什么呢？

lines.en: : How are you and Ayane best friends?! She didn’t even clap!
lines.zh: : 你和 Ayane 怎么可能是最好的朋友？！她连掌都没鼓！

lines.en: : Did ya not hear my applause?!
lines.zh: : 你没听见我的掌声吗？！

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : What do you mean? I just so happened to be transferred into this class.
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？我只是碰巧被转进了这个班而已。

lines.en: : Total coincidence. Kinda crazy, huh?
lines.zh: : 纯属巧合。挺离谱的吧？

lines.en: : Didn’t you transfer classes less than a month ago? What was wrong with your last one?
lines.zh: : 你不到一个月前不是才转过班吗？上一个班怎么了？

lines.en: : I felt my education was lacking in my previous environment and am now looking to improve myself.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在之前的环境中我的学业有所欠缺，现在想提升一下自己。

lines.en: : You have very much come to the wrong class, if that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 如果是这样，那你可真是来错班了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind giving you a list of teachers who, you know, {i}teach{/i} if you have a minute after[school].
lines.zh: : 如果你放学后有空，我不介意给你列一份……你知道的，真的会{i}教{/i}书的老师名单。

lines.en: scene norikointro1
: That won’t be necessary. After giving it some thought, I’ve decided that this is the right class for me.
lines.zh: : 那倒不必。经过一番深思熟虑，我认定了这个班就是适合我的班。

lines.en: : And if anyone has a problem with that, {i}Ayane{/i}, they can take it up with Sensei personally.
lines.zh: : 如果谁对此有意见，{i}Ayane{/i}，他们可以亲自去找 Sensei 谈。

lines.en: : He approved the transfer, so if anyone is to blame here, it’s him.
lines.zh: : 是他批准的转班，所以如果这事儿要怪谁，那就怪他。

lines.en: scene norikointro6
: What?...
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : You could have at least given me a warning, or...
lines.zh: : 你至少可以提前跟我说一声吧，或者……

lines.en: : To be completely honest, she just kind of sprung it on me out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 说实话，她完全是突然袭击，我事先一点都不知道。

lines.en: : You did approve it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你确实是批准了的。

lines.en: : Yes. I did approve it.
lines.zh: : 对。我确实批准了。

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Ayane? I thought you and Kirin were kind of close?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗，Ayane？我还以为你和 Kirin 关系挺好的？

lines.en: scene norikointro7
: Yeah...
: Me too...
lines.zh: : 我也这么以为……

lines.en: scene norikointro8
: Welp, I suppose this concludes my introduction!
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想我的自我介绍到此结束！

lines.en: : I’d like to thank everyone for accepting me to the class and give a special thanks to Miku for making several people awkwardly clap for me.
lines.zh: : 感谢大家接纳我加入这个班，另外特别感谢 Miku，让她成功哄得几个人尴尬地为我鼓了掌。

lines.en: : I totally didn’t hate that at all.
lines.zh: : 我完全没有讨厌那个环节哦。

lines.en: scene black
Kirin grabs her bag off of the ground and makes her way over to an unoccupied desk on the left hand side of the room.
lines.zh: Kirin 从地上抓起书包，走向教室左侧一张没人坐的课桌。

lines.en: She sits next to Io.
lines.zh: 她坐到了 Io 旁边。

lines.en: And, as expected of someone as outgoing as her, she immediately tries to strike up a conversation.
lines.zh: 而正如她这样外向的人该有的表现，她立刻试图搭话。

lines.en: Unfortunately for Kirin, she picked one of the absolute worst people to talk to.
lines.zh: 对 Kirin 来说不幸的是，她挑了最不适合搭话的人之一。

lines.en: Nothing against Io, of course. It’s just...
lines.zh: 当然，我并不是针对 Io。只是……

lines.en: Well-
scene norikointro9
: Hey. Are you new here as well? I don’t remember seeing you at the Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你也是新来的吗？圣诞派对上我不记得见过你。

lines.en: : My old[school] exploded.
lines.zh: : 我以前的[school]炸了。

lines.en: : Ooooh, a transfer then? How are you liking this place compared to the last one?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，那也是转学生咯？和上一所比起来，你喜欢这儿吗？

lines.en: : It’s...a[school], I guess.
lines.zh: : 它……算是一所[school]吧，我想。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, are you trying to become friends or something? Because I’m not really interested.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你是想跟我交朋友还是怎么的？因为我实在没什么兴趣。

lines.en: scene norikointro10
: Uhh...excuse me?
lines.zh: : 呃……你说什么？

lines.en: : Io! You know darn well that’s not how you’re supposed to talk to people you’re meeting for the first time!
lines.zh: : Io！你明明很清楚，跟第一次见面的人不该这么说话！

lines.en: : So, what? You want me to lie to her and tell her I want to paint our nails and go shopping for flowers or something?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你想让我骗她，说我想要一起涂指甲油、去买花之类的？

lines.en: : Yes! Kind of!
lines.zh: : 对！差不多吧！

lines.en: : I want you to actually {i}want{/i} to do that!
lines.zh: : 我要你是真心{i}想{/i}那么做！

lines.en: : Ya can’t just rely on me forever, ya know?
lines.zh: : 你不能一辈子都依赖我啊，知道吗？

lines.en: scene norikointro11
: Please do excuse my rude behavior, Kanda-san.
lines.zh: : 请您务必原谅我的无礼，Kanda 同学。

lines.en: : I would absolutely adore the prospect of painting each other’s nails and perusing the local florist for hydrangeas if you’d be so inclined.
lines.zh: : 如果您愿意的话，我会非常期待与您互相涂抹指甲，并一同前往本地花店细细挑选绣球花。

lines.en: : I kind of like you for some reason.
lines.zh: : 不知为什么，我有点喜欢你。

lines.en: : Please don’t. I am not worth it.
lines.zh: : 请别。我不值得。

lines.en: : Please help.
lines.zh: : 救命。

lines.en: : I can’t do it anymore.
lines.zh: : 我干不下去了。

lines.en: scene norikointro12
: Wakana? What’s up?
lines.zh: : Wakana？怎么了？

lines.en: : Please use my last name in front of the students, you pathetic waste of carbon.
lines.zh: : 在学生面前请称呼我的姓，你这个可悲的碳基废物。

lines.en: : Wakana Watabe, what’s up?
lines.zh: : Wakana Watabe，怎么了？

lines.en: scene norikointro13
: “What’s up” is that I’m going to throw myself off of the roof of this building if you do not get this suspiciously smart but infinitely obnoxious girl out of my classroom {i}immediately.{/i}
lines.zh: : 「怎么了」就是，如果你不{i}立刻{/i}把这个可疑地聪明、又无限惹人烦的女生弄出我的教室，我就从这栋楼的楼顶跳下去。

lines.en: : I will literally pay you. I do not care.
lines.zh: : 我真的会付你钱。我不在乎。

lines.en: : I just can’t take it anymore.
lines.zh: : 我实在受不了了。

lines.en: : Are you going to say your catch phrase?
lines.zh: : 你要说你的招牌台词了吗？

lines.en: scene norikointro14
: I...want...to...fucking...die...
lines.zh: : 我……想……他妈的……死……

lines.en: scene norikointro15
: Wakana! You can’t just walk away in the middle of a discussion!
lines.zh: : Wakana！你怎么能在谈话说到一半的时候就这么走掉！

lines.en: Why does this student know Ms. Watabe’s first name?
lines.zh: 为什么这个学生会知道 Watabe 老师的名字？

lines.en: Why does that make me jealous?
lines.zh: 为什么这会让我嫉妒？

lines.en: Wait, what’s even going on right now?
lines.zh: 等等，现在到底在发生什么？

lines.en: : You are our {i}teacher{/i}. If you are not here to {i}teach{/i}, then why bother-
lines.zh: : 你是我们的{i}老师{/i}。如果你不是来{i}教{/i}书的，那又何必——

lines.en: scene norikointro16
: Getting a...
lines.zh: : 找份……

lines.en: : Job in...
lines.zh: : 教育方面的……

lines.en: : Education...
lines.zh: : 工作……

lines.en: scene norikointro17
: Oh my god...
lines.zh: : 我的天啊……

lines.en: : Oh my god...
lines.zh: : 我的天啊……

lines.en: : Oh my god...you’re here...
lines.zh: : 我的天啊……你在这里……

lines.en: : You...
: You...
: When?
lines.zh: : 什么时候？

lines.en: : How long?
lines.zh: : 多久了？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : If I knew this is where you went...I...I...
lines.zh: : 如果我知道你来了这里……我……我……

lines.en: : I think you might have me confused with someone else.
lines.zh: : 我想你可能是把我认成别人了。

lines.en: scene norikointro18
: Absolutely not! No! I’ve...
lines.zh: : 绝对没有！不！我……

lines.en: : I've looked...{i}everywhere{/i} for you!
lines.zh: : 我……找你找遍了{i}所有地方{/i}！

lines.en: : Well, clearly not everywhere because you’re here and...and {i}I’m{/i} here and...and...
lines.zh: : 好吧，显然不是所有地方，因为你在这里……而……而{i}我{/i}也在这里，然后……然后……

lines.en: scene norikointro19
: And...
lines.zh: : 然后……

lines.en: : I missed you so much...
lines.zh: : 我好想你……

lines.en: : So...{i}fucking{/i}...much...
lines.zh: : 想……{i}他妈的{/i}……要命……

lines.en: : Ever since you left, I’ve been looking online and asking my sister and...
lines.zh: : 自从你离开以后，我一直在网上找你，还问过我姐姐，然后……

lines.en: scene norikointro20
: You are extremely hard to find! You know that?!
lines.zh: : 你真的超级难找！你知道吗？！

lines.en: : Like, who doesn’t have social media nowadays?! I figured even {i}you{/i} would have caved by now, but-
lines.zh: : 我是说，这年头谁还没有社交媒体啊？！我本以为连{i}你{/i}也会屈服的，不过——

lines.en: scene norikointro21
: But I guess it would make sense if you wanted to avoid us...
lines.zh: : 不过如果你想躲开我们，那倒也说得通……

lines.en: : I mean, of course you wanted to get away from...everything that happened...
lines.zh: : 我是说，你当然想逃离……发生过的那一切……

lines.en: : But I always thought that {i}I{/i} was special.
lines.zh: : 但{i}我{/i}一直以为我是特别的。

lines.en: : Because {i}you{/i}...you were special. To me.
lines.zh: : 因为你……你对我{i}来{/i}说是特别的。

lines.en: : The most special thing in the world.
lines.zh: : 是世界上最特别的存在。

lines.en: scene norikointro22
: Holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我操。

lines.en: : Can I hug you?
lines.zh: : 我能抱你吗？

lines.en: : I’m gonna hug you.
lines.zh: : 我要抱你了。

lines.en: : And I’m probably gonna cry a lot.
lines.zh: : 而且我大概会哭得很惨。

lines.en: : But you have...no idea how much I’ve been looking forward to this...
lines.zh: : 可是你……根本不知道我有多期待这一刻……

lines.en: : This is actually quite touching.
lines.zh: : 说实话这还挺感人的。

lines.en: : What is? I have no idea what's even going on.
lines.zh: : 什么感人？我完全不知道现在在发生什么。

lines.en: : What’s going on is I’m going to squeeze the life out of you.
lines.zh: : 现在发生的事就是，我要把你勒到断气。

lines.en: : I deserve it after being as patient as I’ve been all these years.
lines.zh: : 我忍了这么多年，这是我应得的。

lines.en: scene norikointro23
The mysterious, pink-haired girl lunges forward and buries her face in my chest.
lines.zh: 这个神秘的粉发女孩猛地扑上来，把脸埋进我的胸口。

lines.en: Within a matter of seconds, I can feel her tears seep through the fabric of my dress shirt.
lines.zh: 几秒钟之内，我就感觉到她的泪水透过我衬衫的布料渗了进来。

lines.en: She goes through short bursts every several seconds where she sobs uncontrollably.
lines.zh: 每隔几秒，她就会无法控制地抽泣上一小阵。

lines.en: Her fingers dig into my body with so much force that it feels doubtful she’ll ever even contemplate letting go.
lines.zh: 她的手指死死抠进我的身体，那力道让人怀疑她根本没想过要松手。

lines.en: This has to be someone Sensei knew before I took over and started ruining all of his relationships.
lines.zh: 这一定是 Sensei 在我接管之前就认识的人——在我开始毁掉他所有人际关系之前。

lines.en: Or fixing them, depending on your ethical standpoint concerning power dynamics and how to use them to manipulate [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: 或者说修复它们，这取决于你在权力关系以及如何利用它来操控[teenage]女孩这件事上的道德立场。

lines.en: If I had to take a guess, most people would probably consider that ruining them.
lines.zh: 如果非让我猜的话，大多数人大概会认为那是在毁掉它们。

lines.en: If I was the person I’m supposed to be- or if {i}he{/i} was the person {i}he{/i} was supposed to be instead of some memory floating out there in the ether-
lines.zh: 如果我真的是我该是的那个人——或者{i}他{/i}真的是{i}他{/i}该是的那个人，而不是一缕飘在虚空里的记忆——

lines.en: This would be a touching reunion.
lines.zh: 这会是一场感人的重逢。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: I don’t know the details of his relationship with this girl, but-
lines.zh: 我不知道他和这个女孩之间的具体关系，不过——

lines.en: : When was the last time we saw each other?
lines.zh: : 我们上一次见面是什么时候？

lines.en: : Almost three years ago.
lines.zh: : 差不多三年前。

lines.en: : It was on a Thursday.
lines.zh: : 那天是个星期四。

lines.en: : But you disappeared once before that, too.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，你也失踪过一次。

lines.en: : I should have probably just moved on, but...
lines.zh: : 我也许早该放下的，可是……

lines.en: : But I always knew I’d find you again if...
lines.zh: : 可我一直知道，只要我……

lines.en: : If I didn't give up...
lines.zh: : 只要我不放弃……就一定能再找到你……

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: There’s no easy way out of this situation, but...
lines.zh: 这种情况没有轻松的脱身办法，不过……

lines.en: I guess I could play the amnesia card?
lines.zh: 我大概可以打失忆这张牌？

lines.en: That's been my ace in the hole so far, at least.
lines.zh: 至少到目前为止，这一直是我的底牌。

lines.en: Ami already assumes something weird happened to my memory, but it hasn’t personally impacted her all that much, so I guess she just shrugs it off for the most part.
lines.zh: Ami 已经觉得我的记忆出了点怪事，但这对她本人影响不大，所以我想她多半也就耸耸肩不在意了。

lines.en: I mean, just telling whoever this is that I don’t remember her is sure to break her.
lines.zh: 我是说，就这么告诉眼前这个人我不记得她，肯定会把她击垮。

lines.en: If she’s not already broken, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，如果她还没有碎掉的话。

lines.en: But I guess we’re all a little broken at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 不过说到底，我们大概都有点破碎吧。

lines.en: Some more than others.
lines.zh: 有些人碎得更厉害些。

lines.en: Some much, much more than others.
lines.zh: 有些人则碎得厉害得多得多。

lines.en: : There’s something you should probably know.
lines.zh: : 有件事你大概应该知道。

lines.en: scene norikointro24
: There are a lot of things I should probably know. We’ve been out of touch for quite some time now.
lines.zh: : 我大概该知道的事多了去了。我们已经失联很久很久了。

lines.en: : I really...really can’t believe this is happening.
lines.zh: : 我真的……真的不敢相信这一切正在发生。

lines.en: : Neither can I, but...
lines.zh: : 我也不敢相信，不过……

lines.en: : ...But what?
lines.zh: : ……不过什么？

lines.en: : But that’s probably because...something happened to my memory.
lines.zh: : 不过那大概是因为……我的记忆出了点问题。

lines.en: scene norikointro25
: What, like...amnesia?
lines.zh: : 什么，比如说……失忆？

lines.en: : I hope that’s not just a convenient excuse to tell me you forgot about me.
lines.zh: : 我希望那不只是个用来告诉我你把我忘了的方便借口。

lines.en: : To me it’s more like...I never knew you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 对我来说更像是……我一开始就根本不认识你。
: 所以……

lines.en: : You’re saying all of your memories of me are just totally gone?
lines.zh: : 你是说，关于我的记忆全都彻底消失了？

lines.en: : Right...
: And I know it might hurt you to hear that since you’ve been searching for so long but-
lines.zh: : 我知道你找了这么久，听到这个可能会很受伤，不过——

lines.en: scene norikointro26
: Not at all...
lines.zh: : 一点也没有……

lines.en: : Nothing hurts anymore.
lines.zh: : 什么都不痛了。

lines.en: : If your memories are gone, I’ll just figure out a way to get them back.
lines.zh: : 如果你的记忆没了，我就想办法把它们找回来。

lines.en: : We’ll start fresh.
lines.zh: : 我们重新开始。

lines.en: : I am kinda sad, though. I was hoping you’d comment on how tall I’ve gotten.
lines.zh: : 不过我有点难过。我还指望你能夸夸我长高了呢。

lines.en: : I finally had my growth spurt and I think I’ve gotten pretty damn cute, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 我终于迎来了发育期，说实话我觉得自己变得相当他妈的可爱了。

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard to judge that with you so close, but...yeah. I'd say you’re cute.
lines.zh: : 你离得这么近，我实在不太好判断，不过……是啊。我觉得你很可爱。

lines.en: : If we’re starting fresh, would you mind telling me your name?
lines.zh: : 既然要重新开始，能告诉我你的名字吗？

lines.en: : You don’t even remember that much?
lines.zh: : 你连这个都不记得了？
: 我……不记得。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : You don’t ever have to apologize to me. I’ll be with you forever...
lines.zh: : 你永远都不用跟我道歉。我会永远陪着你的……

lines.en: : So long as you don’t run away again, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你别再跑掉了。

lines.en: : My name is Noriko Nakayama and I have been in love with you since I was six years old.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Noriko Nakayama，从六岁起就爱上你了。

lines.en: : Okay, this is suddenly much less touching.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这下突然就不那么感人了。

lines.en: : {i}Nakayama?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Nakayama？……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}...No. There's no way.{/i}
: Uhh...that’s...
: Obviously too young, I know that. But it doesn’t change how I’ve felt all of these years.
lines.zh: : 我知道那显然太小了。但这改变不了我这些年来的感受。

lines.en: : And how I still feel now.
lines.zh: : 也改变不了我现在的感觉。

lines.en: : Want to run away and get married?
lines.zh: : 要不要私奔然后结婚？

lines.en: : Please at least finish the[school] day.
lines.zh: : 至少请把今天的[school]上完。

lines.en: : Noriko, I-
lines.zh: : Noriko，我——

lines.en: scene norikointro27
: Ami? Are you raising your hand right now?
lines.zh: : Ami？你现在是在举手吗？

lines.en: : Who is that?
lines.zh: : 那个人是谁？
: Ami？……

lines.en: : Oh my god, like, {i}[niece]{/i} Ami?!
lines.zh: : 我的天啊，是那个{i}[niece]{/i} Ami 吗？！

lines.en: : She’s so cute now!
lines.zh: : 她现在好可爱啊！

lines.en: : Sensei, who is that?
lines.zh: : Sensei，那个人是谁？

lines.en: : Uhh...I still don’t really understand myself, but-
lines.zh: : 呃……我自己其实也没搞清楚，不过——

lines.en: scene norikointro28
: Maya?...
lines.zh: : Maya？……

lines.en: scene norikointro29
: {size=-15}Why.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}为什么。{/size}

lines.en: : {size=-15}Why?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}为什么？{/size}

lines.en: : {size=-15}Why. Why. Why?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}为什么。为什么。为什么？{/size}

lines.en: scene norikointro30
: {size=+15}WHY ARE YOU HERE?!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=+15}你他妈为什么在这儿？！{/size}

lines.en: scene norikointro31
: It’s...because of that stupid fucking[school].
lines.zh: : 是……因为那所愚蠢透顶的[school]。

lines.en: : Isn't it?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: : That stupid...{b}FUCKING{/b}[school] that decided to {b}SINK{/b} and turn everything on its {b}GOD DAMN{/b}...{b}FUCKING HEAD!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : 那所愚蠢的……{b}操蛋的{/b}[school]，它决定{b}沉掉{/b}，然后把一切都{b}他妈的{/b}翻了个{b}底朝天{/b}！！！

lines.en: Something is wrong.
lines.zh: 有什么不对劲。

lines.en: scene norikointro32
: Get out.
lines.zh: : 滚出去。

lines.en: : Now.
lines.zh: : 现在。

lines.en: : No. I’m not-
lines.zh: : 不。我没有——

lines.en: : I wasn’t asking you. I was telling you.
lines.zh: : 我不是在请求你。我是在命令你。

lines.en: : Get...the fuck...out of my classroom...you filthy...stalker...bitch...
lines.zh: : 给……我滚……出我的教室……你这个恶心的……跟踪狂……婊子……

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’m turned on or terrified right now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我现在是兴奋还是害怕。

lines.en: : Rin! Shh...
lines.zh: : Rin！嘘……

lines.en: : Maya...calm down for a second and-
lines.zh: : Maya……冷静一下，然后——

lines.en: : Get out.
lines.zh: : 滚出去。

lines.en: : Get out get out get out.
lines.zh: : 滚出去滚出去滚出去。

lines.en: : Get. The fuck. Out.
lines.zh: : 给。我。滚。出去。

lines.en: : Fine. Then {i}I’ll{/i} get out.
lines.zh: : 好。那{i}我{/i}出去。

lines.en: scene black
Maya leaves her desk and slowly brings herself to the front of the classroom, stopping in front of the door and staring directly at Noriko.
lines.zh: Maya 离开自己的座位，慢慢走到教室前面，在门前停下，直直地盯着 Noriko。

lines.en: scene norikointro33
: Maya, is everything-
lines.zh: : Maya，一切都还——

lines.en: : Stay out of this, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你别插手，Sensei。

lines.en: : Are you planning on letting go of him any time soon?
lines.zh: : 你打算什么时候松手？

lines.en: : Not a fucking chance.
lines.zh: : 他妈的想都别想。

lines.en: : Never again.
lines.zh: : 再也不会了。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : You {i}did{/i} get taller, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺带一提，你{i}确实{/i}长高了。

lines.en: : But that isn’t going to change anything.
lines.zh: : 但那改变不了任何事。

lines.en: : You were unwanted {i}then{/i}, and you are unwanted {i}now{/i}.
lines.zh: : {i}那时候{/i}没人要你，{i}现在{/i}也没人要你。

lines.en: : No one will ever...in this timeline or others...{i}ever{/i} love you.
lines.zh: : {i}永远{/i}不会有任何人……无论是在这条时间线还是别的……会爱上你。

lines.en: Timeline?...Then-
lines.zh: 时间线？……那么——

lines.en: : We’ll see about-
lines.zh: : 那我们走着——

lines.en: : Burn in hell, you fucking cunt.
lines.zh: : 去地狱里烧着吧，你这个傻逼。

lines.en: scene norikointro34
: Well, shit.
lines.zh: : 哦，操。

lines.en: scene norikointro35
: I see that {i}her{/i} opinion of me hasn’t changed much.
lines.zh: : 看来{i}她{/i}对我的看法没什么变化。

lines.en: : I’ve never seen her act that way before.
lines.zh: : 我从没见过她那个样子。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Guess I’m just lucky, then.
lines.zh: : 那我还真是走运。

lines.en: : What in the world did you do to her?
lines.zh: : 你到底对她做过什么？

lines.en: : I honestly don’t even remember, but...I don’t think I did anything?
lines.zh: : 说实话我也不记得了，不过……我觉得我什么都没做啊？

lines.en: scene norikointro36
: It doesn’t matter, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这不重要。

lines.en: : We’re finally back together.
lines.zh: : 我们终于又在一起了。

lines.en: : Even if you don’t really remember me.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你其实并不记得我。

lines.en: scene norikointro37
: Oh! By the way, hi!
lines.zh: : 哦！对了，大家好！

lines.en: : I’m Noriko and I’m pretty sure I just got kicked out of my last class, so I’ll be in here with you guys from now on.
lines.zh: : 我是 Noriko，我基本上确定我刚被上一节课赶出来了，所以从现在起我就跟你们一起待在这儿了。

lines.en: : My interests include dismantling the patriarchy and eating so much ice cream in one sitting that I puke my brains out.
lines.zh: : 我的兴趣包括推翻父权制，以及一口气吃下超多冰淇淋直到把脑子都吐出来。

lines.en: : And if you ever hear screams or weird voices or just...really loud noise in general coming from my room, that’s just my music.
lines.zh: : 另外，如果你们听到我房间里传出尖叫声、奇怪的人声，或者就是……总之很大的动静，那只是我的音乐。

lines.en: : I promise I am not a serial killer and I’ve only been arrested like two times.
lines.zh: : 我保证我不是连环杀手，而且我只被逮捕过大概两次。

lines.en: : What the fuck, I like {i}her{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 我操，我也喜欢{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : Green haired girl, hang out with me and the pink one sometime.
lines.zh: : 绿头发的那个，找个时间跟我还有粉毛那个一起玩吧。

lines.en: : Oh, dear. That sounds absolutely lovely but I’m afraid I must decline.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。听上去真是美妙至极，不过恐怕我只能谢绝了。

lines.en: scene black
Noriko takes a seat in the back of the class after a few minutes and Wakana informs me that she’s filing for an “emergency transfer” effective immediately.
lines.zh: 几分钟后 Noriko 在教室后排坐了下来，而 Wakana 通知我，她正在申请「紧急调离」，即刻生效。

lines.en: It seems that I’ll be taking care of Noriko from now on as well.
lines.zh: 看来从今往后 Noriko 也要由我来照顾了。

lines.en: And as excited as I am to have yet another girl so willing to fawn all over me-
lines.zh: 虽然又多了一个这么愿意对我百般讨好的女生，让我挺兴奋的——

lines.en: I can’t stop thinking about Maya’s outburst and all of the negative connotations and implications it carries with it.
lines.zh: 我却止不住地去想 Maya 刚才的爆发，以及它所携带的全部负面意味与暗示。

lines.en: Ami tried to go home as well after that, but I convinced her to stay and reassured her that I really have no idea what Noriko was talking about.
lines.zh: 那之后 Ami 也想回家，但我劝她留下来，并向她保证我是真不知道 Noriko 在说些什么。

lines.en: She seemed a lot more nervous than I’ve ever seen her before.
lines.zh: 她看上去比我以往见过的任何时候都要紧张得多。

lines.en: Ayane, on the other hand, remained calm and composed, restoring order to the room in any way she could think of.
lines.zh: 而 Ayane 则始终保持冷静自若，用她能想到的各种方式恢复了教室的秩序。

lines.en: No one bothered saying a word to Noriko other than Kirin.
lines.zh: 除了 Kirin，没有一个人愿意跟 Noriko 说上一句话。

lines.en: Proclaiming your love for me in front of everyone is probably not the best way to introduce yourself to this classroom.
lines.zh: 当着所有人的面宣告对我的爱，大概不是向这个班级做自我介绍的好办法。

lines.en: I’m sure she’ll pay the price for that in the future.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，她将来会为此付出代价的。

lines.en: When[school] ends, I search for Maya.
lines.zh: [school]放学后，我到处找 Maya。

lines.en: I do not find her.
lines.zh: 我没有找到她。

lines.en: The day ends.
lines.zh: 这一天结束了。
